top_choice_rationale: P001 credits targeted protein degradation to Crews and Deshaies (PROTAC concept and first proof of principle) and Handa (cereblon as the thalidomide target, anchoring the glue strand and most CRBN-recruiting degraders). Each seat rests on a distinct, datable step, the induced-proximity mechanism has been reproduced independently for about twenty-five years, and the citation rests on mechanism, not clinical outcome. P003 (Ciulli instead of Handa) is a defensible PROTAC-centred alternative but leaves the glue strand unnamed. P002 is mature and important but outside my expertise and has a single supporter; any award is preferable to none.
